name: oss-docs
description: Open source project documentation maintained by rdlabo

scripts.docs:generate: npm run articles:generate && npm run docs:generate:content
scripts.start:web-site: npm run articles:generate && ng serve web-site
scripts.build: npm run build:docs && npm run build:web-site && npm run docs-agent-router:check
scripts.build:docs: ng build docs && npm run static:prepare && pagefind --site dist/docs/browser --output-subdir pagefind && tsx --test scripts/build-output.test.ts
scripts.build:web-site: ng build web-site && pagefind --site dist/web-site/browser --output-subdir pagefind && tsx --test scripts/web-site-build-output.test.ts
scripts.build:docs-agent-router: npm run docs:generate:content && npm run docs-agent-router:check
scripts.pretest: npm run docs:generate && npm run marketing:validate
scripts.test: tsx --test scripts/translation-code.test.ts scripts/docs-locales.test.ts scripts/docs-translation-review.test.ts scripts/docgen-api.test.ts scripts/docgen-inline-code.test.ts scripts/docgen-readme.test.ts scripts/html-policy.test.ts scripts/markdown-headings.test.ts scripts/localized-heading-anchors.test.ts scripts/package-markdown.test.ts scripts/package-repository.test.ts scripts/github-sponsors.test.ts scripts/bilingual-update-blocker.test.ts scripts/site-contract.test.ts scripts/webview-docs-migration.test.ts scripts/zenn-articles.test.ts scripts/note-articles.test.ts scripts/import-zenn-articles.test.ts scripts/generate-articles.test.ts scripts/article-relations.test.ts scripts/validate-distribution-plan.test.ts scripts/seo-dates.test.ts shared/json-ld.test.ts scripts/seo-audit.test.ts && vitest run scripts/docs-agent-router.test.ts && ng test docs --watch=false && ng test web-site --watch=false
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:docs && npm run deploy:docs-agent-router && npm run deploy:web-site
scripts.deploy:docs-agent-router: npm run docs:generate:content && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/rdlabo-docs-agent-router-wrangler.log wrangler deploy --config wrangler.docs-agent-router.jsonc
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build && npm run deploy:docs:dry-run && npm run deploy:docs-agent-router:dry-run && npm run deploy:web-site:dry-run
scripts.lint: ng lint docs && ng lint web-site
